title: Track-Record Surcharge on Dropped Batches (Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts)
content:
A dropped-batch violation booked on a Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts account carries a track-record surcharge that looks at the account's recent violations.

**Clause.** The track-record surcharge counts the violations recorded on the account less than one whole month before the day the dropped-batch violation is booked: more than 3 of them add 2 points; from 1 up to 3 of them add 1 point; none add nothing.

## Ladder

| Violations recorded on the account less than one whole month before the booking day | Track-record surcharge |
|---|---|
| 4 or more (more than 3) | 2 points |
| 1, 2 or 3 | 1 point |
| None | Nothing |

## Where the count comes from

The count is taken from the account's own list of violation entries: every violation recorded on the account whose date falls less than one whole month before the day of booking, whatever its type. The dropped-batch violation being booked is not yet on the list when the count is taken.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical accounts)

| Violations in the month | Surcharge | Why |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 1 point | 3 is not more than 3 |
| 4 | 2 points | 4 is more than 3 |
| 1 | 1 point | 1 is the lowest count of the middle band |
| 0 | Nothing | None recorded |

A violation dated ten days before the booking day counts; one dated two months before does not.
